Mankrik is an orc quest giver located at Grol'dom Farm in the Northern Barrens and near Razorfen Kraul in the Southern Barrens. Quilboar corpses are littered around him in the Southern Barrens. Mankrik also helps defend Sethria's Roost on Mount Hyjal against the minions of Ragnaros during the quest  [32-35 Daily] The Protectors of Hyjal.

Biography[edit]

This section concerns content related to the original World of Warcraft.

Mankrik and his wife Olgra battled quilboar in a small tauren camp when they were separated by the overwhelming numbers. As he saw his wife being overwhelmed by newcomers, rage came over him as he turned to face his enemies, but they brought him down easily with their vast numbers. He later awoke to a tauren druid tending his wounds — the druid had come across him on the Gold Road as he fell.[1] Filled with uncertainty whether his wife was still alive or not, he stood at the Crossroads every day scouting the horizon for more quilboar to quench his bloodthirst.[2] Thork refused to help him, as he claimed Mankrik's rage clouded his judgment.

Cataclysm[edit]

This section concerns content related to Cataclysm.

He later managed to retrieve the corpse of his wife and bury her, raising a humble monument in her honor. However his thirst for quilboar blood had still not been quenched, killing every single one of them he'd seen since they murdered his wife and burned down his homestead.[3] Still not satisfied with the slaughter of the quilboar at Thorn Hill, he later traveled to the Southern Barrens, realizing that there he would never have peace without his wife, wanting to see the quilboar's very homes razed.[4] It's then hinted that Mahka helps him to settle with his troubles and may be romantically involved.[5]

Horde players fighting in the Molten Front may receive Mankrik as one of their random strike force partners in the daily quest,  [32-35 Daily] The Protectors of Hyjal. He will not join Alliance players. /waving at him counts toward the achievement,  [Have... Have We Met?]

Legion[edit]

This section concerns content related to Legion.

He was present at Grol'dom Farm when the Burning Legion invaded the Northern Barrens.

Mankrik as he appears in Orgrimmar when riding to visit the Zen'shiri Trading Post.

Dragonflight[edit]

This section concerns content related to Dragonflight.

Mankrik visited the Zen'shiri Trading Post in Orgrimmar to buy himself a new sword and a "nice" bracelet for Mahka.

He later appeared alongside Mahka at the renewed Kosh'harg festival in Razor Hill in Durotar. He wasn't part of the Burning Blade clan delegation or any clan delegation.

The War Within[edit]

This section concerns content related to The War Within.

He can be seen outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration, along with Mahka.

Trivia[edit]

  • An unused NPC representing Mankrik[6] is situated in the same ID range as other legendary warriors presumably meant to appear in Skyhold. He and most of these NPCs didn't make it out of the Legion alpha stage.
  • During the Battle for Azeroth beta, Mankrik was initially planned to appear in Stormsong Valley, assisting the player with killing the Briarback quilboar in Briarback Kraul.
  • Mankrik's appears as a legendary card in the Forged in the Barrens expansion for Hearthstone. His flavor text reads: "Relives his nightmare every day a new Horde player is created."

Clan[edit]

This article or section includes speculation, observations or opinions possibly supported by lore or by Blizzard officials. It should not be taken as representing official lore.
Mankrik's hut in the Crossroads.

Mankrik is likely a former member of the Burning Blade clan, as he displayed a Burning Blade banner outside his hut in the Crossroads pre-Cataclysm and wears the same banner on his back in the fashion of a blademaster in Cataclysm. The alternate Draenor's version of Mankrik is explicitly a Frostwolf, but this can be attributed to the differences between the alternate Draenor and the main timeline. Alternatively, the main-universe Mankrik may have decided to leave his original Frostwolf clan to be trained as a blademaster. He does not show any signs of associating with either clan at the Kosh'harg in the Heritage of Draenor questline. During his appearance at the Zen'shiri Trading Post, he rides a white wolf resembling a frost wolf, which may or may not again indicate a connection to the Frostwolf clan.
